Same as 1, but the per-media-type average is a ratio of sums, SUM(Bytes)/SUM(Milliseconds), instead of the average of per-track ratios. The overall figure is still the simple mean of the per-media-type values.
Same as 1, but the overall average is a track-weighted average, meaning the average of per-track Bytes/Milliseconds across all filtered tracks, instead of the mean of per-media-type averages.

queries:
WITH per_type AS (
  SELECT m.MediaTypeId, m.Name AS Name, AVG(CAST(t.Bytes AS REAL) / t.Milliseconds) AS avg_ratio
  FROM Track t
  JOIN MediaType m ON t.MediaTypeId = m.MediaTypeId
  WHERE t.Bytes > 10323804
  GROUP BY m.MediaTypeId, m.Name
),
overall AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_ratio) AS mean_avg FROM per_type
)
SELECT p.Name, p.avg_ratio AS average, p.avg_ratio - o.mean_avg AS difference
FROM per_type p, overall o
WHERE p.avg_ratio > o.mean_avg;
SELECT AVG(ratio) FROM (SELECT SUM(Bytes) * 1.0 / SUM(Milliseconds) AS ratio FROM Track GROUP BY MediaTypeId);
SELECT AVG(CAST(Bytes AS REAL) / Milliseconds)
FROM Track
WHERE /* filter from question 1 */;
SELECT AVG(COALESCE(t.avg_ms, 0))
FROM MediaType m
LEFT JOIN (
  SELECT MediaTypeId, AVG(Milliseconds) AS avg_ms
  FROM Track
  WHERE Milliseconds > (SELECT AVG(Milliseconds) FROM Track)
  GROUP BY MediaTypeId
) t ON m.MediaTypeId = t.MediaTypeId;
SELECT m.Name,
       AVG(t.Milliseconds) AS avg_milliseconds,
       (SELECT AVG(Milliseconds) FROM Track) AS overall_avg_milliseconds
FROM Track t
JOIN MediaType m ON t.MediaTypeId = m.MediaTypeId
WHERE t.Bytes > 10323804
GROUP BY m.MediaTypeId, m.Name;
SELECT AVG(Bytes / Milliseconds) FROM Track;
